requirements.name: ISM-0402 Application security testing
requirements.description: Applications are comprehensively tested for vulnerabilities, using static application security testing and dynamic application security testing, prior to their initial release and any subsequent releases.

requirements.name: ISM-1163 Continuous monitoring plan
requirements.description: Systems have a continuous monitoring plan that includes: conducting vulnerability scans for systems at least fortnightly, conducting vulnerability assessments and penetration tests for systems prior to deployment, including prior to deployment of significant changes, and at least annually thereafter, analysing identified vulnerabilities to determine their potential impact, and implementing mitigations based on risk, effectiveness and cost.

requirements.name: ISM-1422 Development, testing and production environments
requirements.description: Unauthorised access to the authoritative source for software is prevented.

requirements.name: ISM-1698 Scanning for unmitigated vulnerabilities
requirements.description: A vulnerability scanner is used at least daily to identify missing patches or updates for vulnerabilities in online services.

requirements.name: ISM-1700 Scanning for unmitigated vulnerabilities
requirements.description: A vulnerability scanner is used at least fortnightly to identify missing patches or updates for vulnerabilities in applications other than office productivity suites, web browsers and their extensions, email clients, PDF software, and security products.

requirements.name: ISM-1701 Scanning for unmitigated vulnerabilities
requirements.description: A vulnerability scanner is used at least daily to identify missing patches or updates for vulnerabilities in operating systems of internet-facing servers and internet-facing network devices.

requirements.name: ISM-1702 Scanning for unmitigated vulnerabilities
requirements.description: A vulnerability scanner is used at least fortnightly to identify missing patches or updates for vulnerabilities in operating systems of workstations, non-internet-facing servers and non-internet-facing network devices.

requirements.name: ISM-1808 Scanning for unmitigated vulnerabilities
requirements.description: A vulnerability scanner with an up-to-date vulnerability database is used for vulnerability scanning activities.

requirements.name: ISM-1816 Development, testing and production environments
requirements.description: Unauthorised modification of the authoritative source for software is prevented.

requirements.name: ISM-1875 Protecting credentials
requirements.description: Networks are scanned at least monthly to identify any credentials that are being stored in the clear.
